implementation.notes: Phases 1-2 (IMPL-1 to IMPL-12) merged to local main. Phase 3 (IMPL-13 to IMPL-17: suggestion algorithm, suggestion/link endpoints, suggestion model changes, graph API, event durability tests) on feature/phase-3-link-suggestions. Verification: 207 backend tests pass (PostgreSQL via PGlite, fakeredis plus real Redis for durability tests), ruff and mypy clean, 96% coverage; full Docker stack rebuilt and an 18-check end-to-end journey passed through Traefik, including a real Redis stop/start. Not yet verified: concurrent-race IntegrityError branches in auth, search/graph performance on real PostgreSQL (measured on PGlite only). Deviations in docs/implementation-notes.md. Phase 4 (IMPL-18 to IMPL-28: Next.js frontend, structured logging and health checks, Playwright e2e, documentation, final verification) is complete on feature/phase-4-frontend-and-release and awaits user approval to merge to main (stage 5 gate). Phase 4 verification: 241 backend tests pass on real PostgreSQL 15 and real Redis; ruff, format and CI mypy clean; 89 frontend unit tests; lint, typecheck and build clean; 12 Playwright tests pass on the dev stack and again on a clean-clone deployment (cold build 3m46s, verify-deployment.sh all PASS, no secrets in logs); search p95 27-59 ms and graph p95 95 ms at 10,000 notes on real PostgreSQL; 500-node graph renders in 0.64-1.7 s; backup/restore round trip verified. Defects found and fixed by e2e: reload after access-token expiry signed the user out; rate limit throttled /me (now login, register, refresh only). Not verified: auth IntegrityError race branches, TLS, scaling beyond one instance, e2e in CI, low-end-hardware render time. Deviations in docs/implementation-notes.md.
